Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/bucket/solution.py`.

It starts with `tokens = capacity` and `previous = 0`, refills by `(t - previous) * rate` capped at capacity before each event, advances the timestamp, accepts when `cost <= tokens` (subtracting cost), rejects otherwise without spending, records zero-based indices and post-event balances, and returns `{accepted, rejected, remaining, tokens}` using exact integer arithmetic without mutating inputs.
